node.title: KoalaBear m4 A6/S6 genus-zero passport reduction
node.closure: complete degree-15 two-subset class budget plus product-one generation census
node.statement: For the surviving inner-degree-four outer map with A6 or S6 two-subset monodromy and a mandatory 5^3 pole cycle, exactly four geometric genus-zero passports remain: one A6 and three S6 rows. Three are three-point covers and one is a four-point cover. Five other index-compatible rows generate only proper groups of order 60 or 120. Challenge-field descent, split fibers, quartic source-star incidence, and the surviving m4 type remain open.
